VF EMPIRE · ABOUT

The systems house for open intelligence.

VF Empire Corp Ltd is a systems engineering house in Għajnsielem, Gozo, Malta. Since 2019 it has designed the engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models work as complete systems on hardware the owner controls. It is opening its own AI Training Centre.

Malta · C 94160 Incorporated 2019 Local-first by design

WHAT WE DO

One discipline.
Complete systems, to order.

VF builds complete AI systems to order (engine, harness, dashboards and training) for companies that want AI working on metal they own. The model is the cargo; VF builds the machine around it. The software thesis explains why.

Helmsman.

The steering engine for frontier-class open models. It routes work across models, gates every output against evidence and self-heals failures. It runs the VF floor and ships inside every commissioned system.

The harness.

Process supervision, self-heal loops, project memory and evidence discipline: the frame that turns a raw model into a worker. Swap the model, keep the machine.

Command dashboards.

Fleets, lanes, costs and outcomes on one pane of glass. If it runs, it is visible; if it drifts, it pages.

The same discipline runs our own operations: more than 200 specialised agents and more than 60 supervised process lanes, all local-first on owned hardware. Our research measures utilisation: how much real, gated, verified work one model can do per day.

The first complete system to leave the floor was S◉LOCK, a private AI operating system running local-first on hardware you own. Behind it, twenty-two systems are on the build slate, from VF Mail (already serving the first @vfempire.com inboxes on our own metal) to NAV·IT, Guardian Shield, FileIT and VF Wallet.

HOW WE WORK

Local-first.
Verifiable end to end.

Four commitments shape every VF system, and each is written down where you can check it.

On your hardware.

Models, data and controls run on machines the owner holds. Cloud capacity is an option when a client wants it and never a requirement. This site loads no third-party script, font or cookie; see the Privacy Policy.

Gated by evidence.

Every lane ends in a gate: screenshots, checks, evidence. Nothing ships on a model's word alone. Decision authority stays with accountable humans; section 4 of the Terms reads the EU AI Act as an engineering specification.

Verifiable in public.

Public repositories audited clean of secrets, signed releases, reproducible builds and a paid bug bounty. The security posture and the disclosure policy spell out each mechanism.

Built to outlive us.

If VF ever discontinues a product, the source is released, the last signed build stays verifiable and your data format stays documented. The Permanence Guarantee covers every product of the house.

QUESTIONS

Asked.
Answered.

What does VF Empire do?

VF Empire designs complete AI systems: engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models perform reliably on hardware the owner controls. It builds systems to order, runs its own line of local-first products such as VF Mail and NAV·IT, offers fixed-fee CRA and GDPR services, and is opening an AI Training Centre.

Where is VF Empire registered?

VF Empire Corp Ltd is incorporated under the laws of Malta with company number C 94160 and VAT number MT 2686-9431. The registered office is Virgo Louretana, Triq L-Mġarr, Għajnsielem GSM1020, Gozo, Malta, in the European Union. The company has operated since 2019 and the same details appear in the footer of every page.

Who runs VF Empire?

Vincent Falzon founded the company in 2019 and is its Managing Director. Sales enquiries pass an AI discovery pass and then route to him for a call; partnership deals and press interview requests reach him the same day. Every other desk is listed on the contact page.

How are Noirda GmbH and Guardian Network related to VF Empire?

They are the two network companies of the group. Noirda GmbH operates in Germany in property and hospitality, and Guardian Network operates in the United Kingdom in animation and media. VF Empire Corp Ltd in Malta is the systems engineering house. Each company keeps its own site: noirda.solutions and gn-productions.com.

Does VF Empire work with clients outside Malta?

Yes. VF serves Malta, the wider EU, Germany and the United Kingdom in English, German and Maltese. Because every system is built local-first, it ships to hardware the client holds wherever that hardware sits. Fixed-fee services such as the CRA Readiness Audit are scoped for EU manufacturers and deployers.

How do I start a project with VF?

Write to info@vfempire.com with the problem. VF scopes the machine, builds it to tolerance and hands it over with dashboards, documentation and training. An enquiry creates no contract; commissioned work is governed by a written agreement for that engagement, as section 6 of the Terms sets out.
